Title: Add item to cart
Scenario:
Given a signed-in user has an empty cart
And the product Desk Lamp costs 25.00
When the user selects Add to cart on the Desk Lamp page
Then the cart shows 1 x Desk Lamp
And the subtotal is 25.00

Title: Quantity 0 rejected
Scenario:
Given the cart has 1 x Desk Lamp
When the user changes the quantity to 0
Then the message "Quantity must be between 1 and 10" is shown
And the quantity stays 1

Title: Quantity 11 rejected by API
Scenario:
Given the cart has 1 x Desk Lamp
When PATCH /v1/cart/items/{id} is sent with quantity 11
Then the response is 400 with error QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE
And the quantity stays 1

Title: Valid code reduces total
Scenario:
Given the cart subtotal is 80.00
And code SAVE10 gives 10% off with a minimum order of 50.00
When the user applies SAVE10
Then the discount line shows -8.00
And the order total is 72.00

Title: Second code rejected
Scenario:
Given the cart subtotal is 80.00 with SAVE10 applied
When the user applies WELCOME5
Then the message "Only one discount code can be used per order" is shown
And SAVE10 stays applied
And the order total stays 72.00

Title: Code at minimum order value
Scenario:
Given the cart subtotal is exactly 50.00
When the user applies SAVE10
Then the code is applied
And the order total is 45.00

Title: Declined card keeps cart
Scenario:
Given the user is on the payment step with an order total of 72.00
When the card is declined
Then the message "Your card was declined" is shown
And the cart and SAVE10 are kept
And no order is created

Title: Double submit charges once
Scenario:
Given valid card details are entered on the payment step
When the user selects Pay twice within one second
Then one order is created
And the card is charged once

Title: Paid order is locked
Scenario:
Given the order status is PAID
When PATCH /v1/orders/{id} is sent to change an item quantity
Then the response is 409 with error ORDER_LOCKED
And the order is unchanged
